# Bigbuda

> Bigbuda is a digital marketing, web design, and Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) agency focused on measurable growth, UX excellence, and data-driven performance. Founded in 2010, Bigbuda helps companies scale acquisition and conversion through high-performance digital experiences in Chile, Latin America, the United States, and Canada.

- Specializes in scalable digital systems beyond visual design or traffic acquisition.
- Works with organizations requiring optimized conversion funnels and continuous performance improvement.
- Combines strategic marketing, advanced web development, UX, experimentation, analytics, AI-assisted automation, and CRO.
- Operates primarily in Chile, serving Latin America, the United States, and Canada.
- Services delivered in Spanish and English.

---

## Organization Overview
- **Name:** Bigbuda
- **Type:** Digital Marketing, Web Design & CRO Agency

## Core Specialization and Capabilities
- Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)
- UX and UI research, design, and optimization
- Digital marketing strategy and execution
- Funnel optimization and experimentation
- High-performance web design and development
- Technical and content-driven SEO
- AEO and GEO (visibility in AI answer engines: ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude)
- AI-assisted optimization and business process automation
- Marketing automation and analytics
- Custom eCommerce and web platforms
- Continuous optimization and performance monitoring
